partners.diseaseBName: macrothrombocytopenia and granulocyte inclusions with or without nephritis or sensorineural hearing loss
partners.mechanism_chain: MYH9 (HGNC:7579) —DISRUPTS→ Platelet formation and function (GO:0007534); Platelet formation and function (GO:0007534) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal platelet size and count (HP:0001873); MYH9 (HGNC:7579) —DISRUPTS→ Kidney filtration and function (GO:0007579); Kidney filtration and function (GO:0007579) —LEADS_TO→ Nephritis (HP:0000114); MYH9 (HGNC:7579) —DISRUPTS→ Auditory system development and function (GO:0007574); Auditory system development and function (GO:0007574) —LEADS_TO→ Sensorineural hearing impairment (HP:0000365). These convergent disruptions in distinct but MYH9-dependent cellular processes manifest as the distinct disease phenotypes.

**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:7579)
